definitions.gloss: retail store; sales outlet; authorized dealer
definitions.explanation: A shop that sells goods to the public. Often used to refer to authorized or designated retailers for specific brands or products.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最寄|もよ}り→最寄り：28821_moyori⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{販売店|はんばいてん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: To buy at the nearest retail store.

examples.japanese: ⟦{正規|せいき}→正規：03776_seiki⟧{販売店|はんばいてん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧しか⟦{購入|こうにゅう}→購入：03057_kounyuu⟧⟦できません→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: It can only be purchased at an authorized dealer.

examples.japanese: ⟦{全国|ぜんこく}→全国：03311_zenkoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{販売店|はんばいてん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{取|と}り{扱|あつか}い→取り扱い：09806_toriatsukai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{始|はじ}まる→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧。
examples.english: Sales will begin at retail stores nationwide starting next month.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{販売|はんばい}→販売：03573_hanbai⟧ (sales) + ⟦{店|てん}→店：10011_ten⟧ (shop). A general term for any shop that sells goods. In practice, often used with qualifiers to indicate the type of store.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{正規|せいき}→正規：03776_seiki⟧{販売店|はんばいてん}: authorized dealer
- {特約|とくやく}{販売店|はんばいてん}: exclusive dealership
- ⟦{指定|してい}→指定：00373_shitei⟧{販売店|はんばいてん}: designated retailer
- {販売店|はんばいてん}⟦{一覧|いちらん}→一覧：17694_ichiran⟧: list of retail stores

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{小売店|こうりてん}→小売店：20689_kouriten⟧: retail shop — more specific to retail (as opposed to wholesale)
- ⟦{取扱店|とりあつかいてん}→取扱店：24107_toriatsukaiten⟧: authorized handler/dealer — emphasizes being licensed to sell
- ⟦{卸売店|おろしうりてん}→卸売店：24113_oroshiuriten⟧: wholesaler — sells in bulk to other businesses
